record_audits.database_subject: Isolation and partial characterization of cyclic lipopeptide antibiotics produced by Paenibacillus ehimensis B7
record_audits.database_comments: Chemical modification: An N-terminal lipidated cyclic antibiotic with nonstandard amino acid Dab at positions 1, 3, and 6 (Warning: Dab, 2,4-diaminobutanoic acid, is two CH2 units less than lysine, although represented by K here in the sequence), D-amino acids for F4 and V7. The ring structure is proposed to occur between the C-terminal carboxylic and hydroxyl group of the N-terminal fatty acid portion. PE1 and PE2 share the same peptide backbone but have different fatty acid chains (C-end-OCHRCH2CO-N-end: R is C4H9 for PE1 and C3H7 for PE2). Because of the same amino acid sequence, PE1 and PE2 share this AP number. Activity: Both compounds are active against S. epidermidis CMCC 26069, S. aureus ATCC 25923, S. aureus ATCC 43300, E. coli ATCC 35318, E. coli 5539, P. aeruginosa ATCC 27853, P. aeruginosa 5215, and fungus C. albicans ATCC 10231 (MIC 1-8 ug/ml), better than polymyxin B in certain cases.

sequence_check.primary_source_statement: Primary source supports a cyclic lipopeptide backbone with Dab residues, D-Phe/D-Val, Ile/Leu ambiguity, and PE1/PE2 fatty-acyl differences; APD6 linear K representation is retained as modified/not-normalized.

record_audits.review_notes: APD6 shares one AP number for PE1 and PE2 and represents nonstandard Dab as K; source supports the modified cyclic lipopeptide family but not a simple unmodified linear peptide sequence.
record_audits.conflict_context: sequence_modified_not_normalized: primary article reports nonstandard residues, stereochemistry, cyclic lactone linkage, and fatty-acyl variants; database linear notation is useful but not normalized to a source-exact sequence.
